alerts.title: Corridor Hydrological Vigilance Advisory (Rangpo-Singtam)
trigger_reasons: 72-hour antecedent rainfall accumulation reached 30.8mm at Singtam station
Moderate saturation along colluvial road cuts in Majhitar-Bardang reach
recommended_actions: Maintain continuous telemetry monitoring on MEMS inclinometers at Bardang
Inspect culvert weep-drain outlets for silt blockage
Pre-position heavy earthmoving machinery at Bardang maintenance depot

lifecycle.acknowledged_by: Duty Officer (State Emergency Operation Centre - SEOC)
